recommendation_basis: C3 is the smallest coherent transfer: one pure function, three threshold fixtures, two detected mutations, and no effect-trace adapter. It can test reusable property-to-counterexample mechanics with less adapter-specific uncertainty than P4.

options.property: For integer limit_value, return 1/2 when limit_value is at least 100 and 2/5 otherwise.
limits: the consumer implementation anchor is unavailable in the current checkout

options.property: When total payout is positive and no payout exists, emit exactly one payout write followed by one PayoutCreated event with matching amount and end date.
advantages: tests observable distributed effects and ordering
closer to a business-process assurance service
limits: only the eligible-payout fixture is present
zero-payout and duplicate-payout converses are explicitly excluded
effect observation has a larger adapter-specific trust surface
the consumer implementation anchors are unavailable in the current checkout

options.property: Evaluate C3 first, then create an independently bounded P4 package.
advantages: measures reuse across pure and effectful targets
limits: requires two freezes, evaluations and independent replays
must not combine denominators or promotion decisions

options.property: Owner supplies a bounded replacement semantic and fixtures before binding.
advantages: can close known business-rule gaps before evaluation
limits: requires a new owner-confirmed definition and denominator

options.property: Stop after the L2 CRABS assurance result.
advantages: avoids claiming transfer without an owner-confirmed financial property
